content.title: Los Angeles Lakers vs Chicago Bulls Live Stream: How To Watch NBA
content.text: Josh Giddey and the Chicago Bulls take on Luka Doncic and the Los Angeles Lakers for the first time this season on Monday. After missing 11 straight games, Josh Giddey is back for the Chicago Bulls (23-22) on Monday. He is knocking off the rust coming off the bench, which has led to back-to-back wins. In those two games, Giddey has totaled 25 points, 15 assists,and 14 rebounds off the bench. Chicago goes for a third straight win with Giddey in the lineup and a fifth straight overall at home against the Los Angeles Lakers (27-17). This is the fourth game for Los Angeles on the annual “Grammys” road trip. They have won two of the first three as they hit the halfway point of this eight-game road trip. The last time these teams played, Giddey was the hero in one of the best games of last season. Chicago won 119-117 at home on a half court heave as time expired to win the game. Giddey finished with 25 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists to lead the 16-point comeback. Austin Reaves gave Los Angeles a two-point lead with three seconds on the clock. Giddey nailed the half court three-pointer to cap the final 75 seconds of regulation, where Kevin Huerter, Patrick Williams and Coby White all hit three-pointers to put pressure on the Los Angeles defense.
